description: Write a 9 KB structured onboarding guide that follows an outline.

contract.objective: Write guide.md, an onboarding guide for the fictional Atlas command-line tool, following outline.md in the task workspace. Use atlas-reference.md as the authoritative configuration schema and command reference; no real Atlas installation or service is needed. Use the eight section headings from the outline as second-level headings in the same order, cover every fact the outline lists, and include worked command examples. The guide should be thorough: at least 9000 bytes.
acceptance_criteria: guide.md follows the outline's eight sections in order
Every fact in the outline appears in the guide
guide.md includes a complete parseable TOML configuration example in a fenced toml code block, matching atlas-reference.md
